title: Symphony of Illumination
cn: 第 12 集 · 灯光交响曲
novel: Robin received some [[bad news|bad news]] that [[shattered|shatter]] her heart. She found out she could not have children. She felt [[devastated|devastate]] and did not know how to tell anyone. She decided to [[lie|lie]] about it and [[pretended|pretend]] everything was fine. She put on a [[brave|brave]] face and went about her day as if nothing happened. Inside, she was [[breaking|break]] apart. She could not bring herself to share the news with her friends. Meanwhile, Marshall [[hung|hang]] Christmas [[decorations|decoration]] on his suburban house. He wanted to create the most [[spectacular|spectacular]] light display in the [[neighborhood|neighborhood]]. He spent hours climbing up and down the ladder, carefully placing each light. Lily watched him with a mixture of [[pride|pride]] and [[amusement|amusement]]. Marshall was so proud of his work that he invited everyone to come see the lights. Robin sat among her friends, smiling and laughing, but her eyes told a different story. She thought about the children she would never have and felt a deep [[sorrow|sorrow]]. She watched Marshall and Lily prepare for their baby and felt a [[sting|sting]] of [[jealousy|jealousy]]. Ted noticed that Robin seemed [[quiet|quiet]] that evening. He asked if she was okay, and she said she was just tired. Robin kept her [[secret|secret]] locked inside, afraid of what her friends would think. She told herself she would be fine, but she knew it would take time to heal.

pretend.en: to act as if something is true

decoration.en: things used to make things look pretty
